name: the window advice goes back to reading only the clock
find:
clean = index is not None and ceiling is not None and index <= ceiling
    may_open = clean and not climbing
replace:
clean = True
    may_open = clean and not climbing

name: a rising reading stops withholding the open window
no reading is treated as clean air
find: clean = index is not None and ceiling is not None and index <= ceiling
replace: clean = index is None or (ceiling is not None and index <= ceiling)

name: the server stops sending the decision
the page stops showing the reason the advice changed
